reviews.review_title: This game is a love letter to VR.
reviews.review_description:
Hey there, I’m Zarlock. I’ve been a moderator for a while, and a playtester for longer. From the gameplay, to the visuals, this has by far been my favorite game I’ve seen on Vr in 4 years. The game uses gliding based movement, and traditional gorilla tag movement. but the way it’s implemented shows that the devs know good game design, and overall, the quality transfers to the rest of the game. While i haven’t tried the newest gamemode, i trust it’s extremely fun and well designed. The community is helpful and nice, and that’s all I’ve seen since the first playtest. The developers are extremely knowledgeable about their craft, and listen to the community. If the developers didn’t care about the community, I wouldn’t have all the stuff I’ve suggested, but I do have them, so that’s a testament to the personality of the team, and i see a lot of that in the community too. All of this boils down to this message:
“This is the best game and community I’ve ever seen. Thanks for the wizard stuff.”

I know this game hasn’t quite released because you can’t go in a server yet, but that doesn’t change anything. It’s actually really fun. I can tell this is gonna be a game that I’m probably not gonna be bored for a very long time.

The game RuNuts is really fun and there’s many details that go into it. Starting off with the gameplay and what you expect. When I first played this game my expectations were blown to smithereens as I thought this was gonna be another slop vr game that has absolutely no effort into it at all. I was very wrong as you are a squirrel that fights other squirrels in an arena with guns But that’s not just what this game is all about. As there is superpowers you can use, and your also able to fly around the map. So if you put it all together you imagine squirrels fighting with guns flying or using superpowers to try and win the game. Now the way you win the game is by getting 10 kills in the arena.
 But something I think is more important is the fact that there is near none micro transactions in the game leading to a fair player base and by the way the player base is not divided for free to play or pay to win so lobbies aren’t divided and toxic to other players leading to more people socializing and making friends. One things that seems cool to me is the level up system. The level up system works by getting gems or kills for xp and when you reach a certain amount of xp you level up. The thing about this is that at specific marks you may unlock new superpowers to use in the arena. Another thing I would call fun is that there are quests you can do for gold nuts which is the currency in the game. The gold Nuts can be used to purchase super powers after unlocking them through level and getting cosmetics for your squirrel to wear.

Yeah I will be keeping up for the release of this fun game and see where it goes in the future.
